independenceStatement: This round-three review was performed independently from generation, implementation, and the other critic roles. Every score is based on the exact archived original, 324 by 405 mobile, feed, carousel, mechanism, and old-versus-new pixels at the declared hashes. Prompts, HTML, route names, and manifest claims were not treated as evidence that a communication idea works.

decisionPolicy.performanceLens: Two-second comprehension, stop power, brand attribution, save or share utility, Arabic or English scan behavior, carousel progression, feed sequencing, credibility, and whether the communication idea survives without implementation metadata were assessed through the common eight-dimension rubric.
